meta.description: Circuit presets, circuit formats, circuit-only motions and section tags for the Workout Tracker catalog. Companion to the per-body-part data files.
meta.sources: Instagram saved-reel scan + Instagram circuit search (staged-routines-r1), Nerd Fitness circuit training guide (staged-circuits-web-r1), Sam Zellien mobility reel.

circuits.name: Stepper HIIT
circuits.notes: 7 moves on an aerobic step platform, 40s work / 20s rest, 5 rounds, exactly as labeled in the reel. Contains jumping. Source's calorie claim not carried.

circuits.name: Arms & Back Tabata
circuits.notes: Light dumbbells (1-2 kg in source). 20s work / 10s rest x 3 rounds, sequence from the reel caption.

circuits.name: Full-Body Dynamic Warm-Up
circuits.notes: Narrated warm-up sequence in the reel's order; per-move durations/reps not stated in source.

circuits.name: Daily 100
circuits.notes: Merged from two saves of the same creator's daily-100 routine (#8 + #14 in the scan). 100 reps per move. Reel #8's voiceover lists a 4th move that could not be identified (see partials). Fat-loss claims in the voiceover not carried.

circuits.name: Easy Standing Home Routine
circuits.notes: Gentle kneeling/standing mobility-style sequence; reps/durations not stated in source. Source's waist/back-pain claims not carried.

circuits.name: In-Bed Back Mobility
circuits.notes: 5 supine movements performed on a bed, ~20 reps each in the source. Back-pain relief claims not carried - movements staged on merit as gentle mobility.

circuits.name: Gentle Yoga Flow
circuits.notes: Timed holds from the reel: Malasana 2-3 min, Chakki Chalanasana 2-3 min, Baddha Konasana 3-4 min, Malasana Walk 1-2 min. The reel's PCOS/period-relief claims are medical claims and are NOT carried - staged as a gentle yoga/mobility flow only.

circuits.name: Seated Posture Mobility
circuits.notes: Seated sequence with stated reps: elbow pullback (catalog scapular-squeeze) x25, external rotation x20, arm stretch x15, scapular mobility x20.

circuits.name: Hip Mobility Stretches
circuits.notes: 5 labeled hip stretches in the reel's order; hold durations not stated in source.

circuits.name: Home 50-Rep Circuit
circuits.notes: 4 moves x 50 reps each, as guided by on-screen text. Fat-loss framing in the reel title not carried.

circuits.name: 3-Minute Full-Body HIIT
circuits.notes: 6 moves in 20-second intervals with an on-screen timer (3-minute total in source); rest between moves not explicitly stated.

circuits.name: Dumbbell Full-Body Routine
circuits.notes: 4 dumbbell movements in the reel's order (goblet squat performed with a dumbbell in the reel; catalog entry is the kettlebell version - same movement). Sets/reps not stated in source.

circuits.name: Modified Low-Impact Cardio Circuit
circuits.notes: Every move is the modified version in the source: step jacks instead of jumping jacks, step-back burpee (no jump), marching high knees, side steps, marches. 30s per move, 60s rest between rounds, 3 rounds. Rest between moves not stated. Source's weight-loss framing not carried.

circuits.name: Kitchen-Counter Beginner Rep Circuit
circuits.notes: Rep-based, done twice through (100 reps per round, 200 total): calf raises 10, side leg raises 10/side, standing leg extensions 10/side, high-knee marches 20, counter incline push-ups 10, squats 10, sumo squats 10 (bodyweight in source; catalog sumo entry is the KB version). Kitchen counter used for balance. Same creator posted a near-identical version (reel/DdANlQCOzQr) - deduplicated. Source's fat-loss/toning claims not carried.

circuits.name: All-Standing 25-Rep Circuit
circuits.notes: All standing, no floor work, no jumping. 25 reps per move (oblique crunches 25 per side). Source gives rounds as a range: 2-4 sets. Presented by the creator as joint-friendly.

circuits.name: Chair-Supported Low-Impact Circuit
circuits.notes: One folding chair; about half the moves seated, the rest chair-supported. Reps: chair high knees 20, chair squats (= sit-to-stand) 20, seated toe touches 20, chair leg raises 20, seated good mornings 20, oblique crunches 20/side, single-leg step-ups 10/side (bodyweight in source; catalog step-up is the KB version). Source gives rounds as a range: 2-3 sets.

circuits.name: Simple 3-Round Home Full-Body Circuit
circuits.notes: Push-ups 12, air squats 12, forearm plank 30s, reverse lunges 12/side (bodyweight in source), running in place 30s, dips on a bed edge 12. Rest between moves not stated. The reel opens with a warm-up (arm swings / jumping jacks / hip stretch) that is not part of the circuit.

circuits.name: Starter Calisthenics Base Circuit
circuits.notes: Push-ups 10, squats 15, seated leg raises 10, mountain climbers 30 reps, hollow hold 20s. Rest between moves not stated. Hollow hold is the one higher-skill move in the set.

circuits.name: 5-5-5 Devil's Press Circuit
circuits.notes: Two dumbbells (weight not stated). 5 moves x 5 reps x 5 rounds, 60s rest between rounds. Advanced-leaning: devil's press finishes every round.

circuits.name: Single-Dumbbell Descending Ladder (E2MOM x 10)
circuits.notes: One dumbbell. Every 2 minutes x 10 rounds: per arm, deadlift 5, hang power clean 4, push press 3, devil press 2, cluster 1 - finish the ladder on one arm, then the other, inside the same 2-minute window; rest is the remainder of the window. Creator used 17.5 kg and advises a challenging-but-unbroken weight.

circuits.name: Single-Dumbbell Unilateral Complex
circuits.notes: One dumbbell, medium-to-heavy. All 5 moves x 6 reps on one side, then switch sides = 1 round; 6 rounds per side; rest 90-120s between rounds (source range, staged as stated).

circuits.name: 5x5 EMOM Dumbbell Complex
circuits.notes: Two dumbbells. Start a round at the top of every 2-minute window: 5 reps of each of 5 moves (25 reps/round), 10 rounds (20 min); rest is the remainder of each window. Weight not stated - creator advises a load that allows efficient movement with good form. Source's transformation claims not carried.

circuits.name: Snatch & Front-Rack High-Rep Circuit
circuits.notes: Two dumbbells (creator used 35 lb, 'adjust as needed'). 20 reps per move, 4 rounds (320 total reps), minimal rest between exercises, 60s after each round. High-volume conditioning end of the dumbbell set.

circuits.name: Tyson Push-Up + Devil Press Pair
circuits.notes: Two-move finisher pair: 8 reps each, 5 rounds, 90s rest between rounds. Creator used 55 lb dumbbells in the video (aspirational load, not a default).

circuits.name: Standing Dumbbell Core Circuit
circuits.notes: Fully standing, one dumbbell. Single overhead marches 10/side, knee-to-elbow crunches 10/side (dumbbell at chest; catalog standing cross-body crunch is the same family), around the worlds 10, halo to woodchops 10/side, uppercut punches 45s. 4 rounds. No separate rest stated. Evidence: on-screen text in the reel (caption confirms the 'Standing Abs' title only).

circuits.name: No-Rest 30-Second Ab Circuit
circuits.notes: 4 moves x 30s back-to-back with NO rest between moves (2 min of work per round). Source prescribes 1-4 rounds with 3-4 minutes rest between rounds - staged with the range as stated.

circuits.name: Plank-Family Circuit
circuits.notes: Every move starts from plank, 20s each, 5 sets; 60s rest between rounds per the creator's comment reply. A near-identical repost exists under @lisafiittworkouts - counted once.

circuits.name: Kettlebell & Medicine-Ball Core Finisher (40/20)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified protocol: kneeling kettlebell halo 40s, forearm-plank medicine-ball hand-to-hand pass 40s, feet-elevated plank pull-through (kettlebell dragged side to side) 40s; 40s work / 20s rest, 3 rounds, 60s between rounds. Gym-equipment finisher (KB, med ball, box/bench for feet).

circuits.name: 4-Move Core Finisher (30/20)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified: 30s work / 20s rest between moves, 4 rounds (~8 min per caption). High-energy, jump-heavy finisher. A related 15s-per-move variant circulates under the same creator and @romove.method - not staged separately.

circuits.name: Kettlebell Ab Circuit Finisher
circuits.notes: Caption-verified: kettlebell toe touches 20 reps, reverse plank hold 20s, bicycle crunches 20 reps, flutter kicks 20 reps; 3 rounds, 60s rest between rounds. One kettlebell.

circuits.name: 7-Minute Classic (30/10)
circuits.notes: The classic 'Scientific 7-Minute Workout' sequence: 12 moves, 30s work / 10s rest, 1 round (7 min 20s of intervals). Chair/bench needed for step-ups (bodyweight in source; catalog step-up is the KB version) and triceps dips (catalog bench-dip). Side plank switches sides halfway.

circuits.name: 10-Minute Full-Body Circuit (45/15)
circuits.notes: 10 moves x (45s work / 15s rest) = 10 min per round; source says repeat 2-3 times (range staged as stated). 'High knee taps' mapped to high-knees; 'plank side to side' mapped to plank-hip-dips. Core-heavy back half. Source made claims (not carried).

circuits.name: EMOM 16 - Full-Body Metcon
circuits.notes: 16 minutes = 4 rounds of a 4-minute block. Minute 1: burpee box jump over x8; minute 2: renegade row x10; minute 3: DB snatch x12 (6/6); minute 4: DB forward lunge x14 (7/7, dumbbells held at sides). Finish the reps, rest the remainder of the minute (rest rule stated in the caption, in Persian, alongside the English workout list). Needs dumbbells + a plyo box.

circuits.name: Tabata Dumbbell Full-Body (20/10 x 10)
circuits.notes: Pair of dumbbells. 6 moves, 20s on / 10s off, 10 rounds, 60s break between rounds. Name staged from the format: the source titles it '3 Min' (one round); the full session is ~39 min. Not a clone of the arms & back Tabata (different moves, 10 rounds vs 3). Source made claims (not carried).

circuits.name: 7-Minute Muay Thai Chair Circuit (45/15 x 3)
circuits.notes: One chair. Caption version staged: 45s on / 15s off, 7 moves, 3 rounds, 1 min rest between circuits (on-screen text said '2-3x'). Elevated push-ups staged as incline push-ups on the chair; source title '7 Minute' is one round - full session ~23 min. Only martial-arts-flavoured circuit in the set.

circuits.name: Dumbbell Circuit (40/20 x 2)
circuits.notes: Pair of dumbbells (creator used 10 lb). 4 compound combo moves, 40s work / 20s rest, 2 rounds. Name staged from the format: the source's '10 minutes' title sums to 8 min of stated intervals.

circuits.name: EMOM 24 - Dumbbell Full-Body
circuits.notes: Alternate find (fully specified; held back by the researcher only to keep the time-boxed set format-diverse). 24-minute timer: 20 reps at the start of each minute, rest the remainder, rotate through 6 exercises, 4 rounds. Pair of dumbbells (creator used 2 x 20 lb). Structure is caption-verified; move names rest on the video summary - 'squats' staged as db-front-squat (dumbbells in hand).

circuits.name: EMOM 15 - Full-Body (Work Minutes + Rest Minute)
circuits.notes: Alternate find (fully specified). 5-minute block x 3 rounds = 15 min: minute 1 suitcase squat, minute 2 alternating DB snatch, minute 3 push-up toe touches, minute 4 mountain climbers, minute 5 REST (the rest minute is part of the block, hence 4 motion ids for 5 minutes). Work fills the full minute - no rep targets, unlike EMOM 16/24. Dumbbells.

circuits.name: Morning Mobility - 15-Move Athlete Flow
circuits.notes: Single sequence (presented as a 5-10 min morning routine; no rounds). Per-move doses from on-screen labels: pogo jumps 30s, body twists 30s, body waves 30s, elephant walks 10/leg, squat hold 30s (staged as deep-squat-hip-stretch), thoracic rotations 5/side, cossack squats 5/side, pancake fold 30s, world's greatest stretch 5/side, cat-cow 10, thread-the-needle 5/side, 90/90s 10, 90/90 folds 5/side, shoulder dislocations 5 (staged as shoulder-swings - stick/band pass-through), trunk twists 5 (second torso-twist station, as listed in the source). A resistance band appears in the source for the dislocation work. Evidence: on-screen labels / search summary (caption only titles the routine).

circuits.name: Chair Mobility Circuit (No Floor Work)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified: seated frog rotations 30s, seated frog twist and reach 30s, foot-elevated hip flexor-hamstring flow 5/side, foot-elevated world's greatest stretch 5/side, hands-elevated cat-cow 30s; repeat 2x through (~5 min). One chair; no floor work, no kneeling. Distinct from the staged seated posture routine (different movement family).

circuits.name: Hip Mobility Flow - Knee Stirs to Frog Rocks
circuits.notes: Single timed floor sequence: knee stirs (supine) 60s, 90/90s 60s, 90/90 lift-offs 30s/leg, all-fours hip circles 30s/leg, frog rocks 60s. Evidence: on-screen labels / search summary (caption recommends it before workouts / on recovery days but does not list the moves).

circuits.name: Hip, Ankle & Spine Mobility (Sets-Based)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified sets per move: hip active stretch 10 reps + 10s hold x3, kneeling ankle mobility 60s + 10 reps/side x3, deep squat heel raises 20 reps x3 (holding a block), full lotus forward fold 20s hold/side x1-2, full lotus sphinx 20s hold/side x1-2, cobra hip & spine rotation 10s hold + 10s rotation/side x1-2. Yoga mat + block. CAUTION: the two full-lotus moves are advanced - flagged in their motion entries; the source supplies no easier substitute.

circuits.name: Desk Chest-Opening Flow (Foam Roller)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified: 4 moves held 1 minute each (4 min total), hips in a bridge over a foam roller placed horizontally under the upper back. Foam roller + mat. Source's desk/neck-tension claims not carried.

circuits.name: Good Morning Mobility (5 Minutes)
circuits.notes: Single timed sequence summing to 5 min: neck circles in upward dog 30s, downward dog calf walk 30s, alternating pigeon pose 60s (catalog pigeon-pose), runner's lunge rotations 60s, kneeling side bends 60s, chin tuck spinal extensions 60s. Evidence: on-screen labels / search summary (caption only says 'Just 5 minutes').

circuits.name: Standing No-Jumping Dumbbell Circuit (45/15 x 3)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified (creator's numbered list; 'NO JUMPING Fullbody'). Light dumbbells (creator used 1 kg). Moves: step squat + back, alternating row (catalog alternate-arm-rows), squat + twist high knee, curtsy + arm lift, lunge + high knee kick right, then left (same motion id listed twice, as the source numbers them separately). Same creator as the scan's arms & back Tabata - a different reel.

circuits.name: No-Jumping Rep Cardio Circuit (x 4 Rounds)
circuits.notes: Rep-based, 4 rounds (on-screen). Knee drives 20/side (staged as standing-knee-raises), squat to side crunch 10/side, sumo squat to calf raise 20, slow skaters 15/side (stepping form, no leap), mountain climbers 20/side, plank reaches 15/side (staged as plank-reach-outs). No timed rest stated. Caption confirms no-jumping, knee-friendly framing. This exact template circulates under at least 3 other creators (@befitwith_sakshi, @vaishali_yadav_5189, @fit_for_takeoff) - staged once, from this post. Source's fat-loss claims not carried.

circuits.name: Dumbbell No-Jumping Cardio Circuit (20/10 x 2)
circuits.notes: Caption-verified as 'without jumping' (caption title: 'NO JUMPING, BUT STILL SWEATY!'). Pair of dumbbells. Squat to overhead press staged as db-thruster (same movement, standing, no jump). Source's calorie-burn claims not carried.

circuits.name: Standing No-Jumping Six-Move Interval Circuit (20/10)
circuits.notes: One pass through 6 moves, 20s work / 10s rest (the source labels each interval a 'round'). Source variations staged onto catalog motions: knee-to-chest drives with arms overhead = standing-knee-raises; side leg lifts with arms extended = standing-hip-abduction; step-out jack = step-jacks; squats with upward arm swings = bodyweight-squat; high knees with hands behind head = high-knees; side lunges reaching overhead = side-lunge. Source's belly-fat framing not carried.

circuits.name: Warm-Up Circuit
circuits.equipmentTheme: Bodyweight; jump rope for the advanced variant
circuits.restGuidance: Continuous, easy pace — the goal is to raise temperature and loosen joints, not to tire out.
circuits.notes: The standard version is a loose ~5-minute menu (the article gives options, not fixed reps). The advanced variant is a fully prescribed list. Maps to warm-up content rather than the Circuits section.

formats.name: Rounds Circuit (standard)
formats.definition: A fixed list of exercises (stations) performed back to back for a set number of rounds, with little or no rest between stations and at most a short rest between rounds.
formats.source: Nerd Fitness circuit training guide (article's core model)

formats.name: AMRAP
formats.definition: As Many Rounds As Possible: cycle through a fixed circuit continuously inside a set time box, tracking completed rounds and reps as the score.

parameters.timeBoxMin: commonly 10-20 (12 and 15 used in the source circuits)

formats.source: Adamas CrossFit format explainer; Gold's Gym acronym guide

formats.name: EMOM
formats.definition: Every Minute On the Minute: at the start of each minute, perform the prescribed reps for that minute's exercise; whatever time remains in the minute is rest.
formats.source: Gold's Gym acronym guide; Adamas CrossFit format explainer

formats.name: Tabata (20/10)
formats.definition: Eight cycles of 20 seconds of maximal-effort work and 10 seconds of rest — four minutes total per exercise block — from the 1996 Tabata protocol research.
formats.source: Tabata et al. 1996 study summary (Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise), via Parade and Canadian Running explainers

formats.name: Ladder / Pyramid
formats.definition: The same set of exercises is repeated each round while the rep target climbs (ascending ladder), falls (descending ladder), or climbs then falls (pyramid).
formats.source: CrossFit format references (Adamas CrossFit; Rhapsody Fitness dictionary rep-scheme examples)

formats.name: Timed Stations
formats.definition: Each station is performed for a fixed work interval with a short transition interval to move to the next station, repeated for a set number of rounds.
formats.source: Nerd Fitness circuit training guide (station concept); interval-timer references

formats.name: Chipper (For Time, single pass)
formats.definition: One long list of exercises with high rep counts, worked through once from top to bottom as fast as good form allows; large sets may be split into smaller sets as needed.
